messages:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up: Greenhouse webhook dropped again — a few interview scorecards didn't make it into the ATS. Anyone seen this? Need quick patch plan + interviewer training note.

Carlos (Recruiter Ops): saw 4 missing scorecards for SDE loop. GH returned 422 on save. I retried but webhook retries were exhausted :grimacing:

GreenhouseBot: ERROR: webhook delivery failed (422) payload: scorecard_id missing candidate_id=CR-12345

Jared (EngOps): I'll pull delivery logs and retry queue now. Can someone paste a sample payload that failed? Might be a client-side form issue.

Anika (Hiring Manager): We had 3 interviews yesterday. Candidates ask for updates. Not ideal.

Carlos (Recruiter Ops): Sample payload (sanitized):
```
{
  "candidate_id": "CR-12345",
  "interview_id": "INT-987",
  "scores": [
    {"competency":"system_design","score":4},
    {"competency":"coding","score":5}
  ]
}
```

Jared (EngOps): Thanks — looks fine. GH error suggests missing scorecard template id. Could be front-end failing to attach the template id when interviewers use mobile.

Priya (People Ops): Action items: 1) Patch ATS entries for affected candidates, 2) short async interviewer note about 'Save & Submit' and mobile caveats, 3) add a checkbox in the interview invite to confirm scorecard completion. I can draft.

Eli (Interview Training): I can build a 5-min Loom + a one-pager checklist. Recommend we call out: always click 'Submit final scorecard' and avoid closing tab until spinner finishes. Also show how to save locally if offline.

Carlos (Recruiter Ops): For the patch — I'll export candidate list and add a manual scorecard entry. Can someone own the GH ticket?

Jared (EngOps): I'll open a support ticket with Greenhouse with delivery logs and sample payload. Also enabling retry window to 24h temporarily.

Maya (People Ops): Great. Please add all notes to #hiring-ops-issues board. Deadline to have training note + Loom: EOD tomorrow. Thanks :thumbsup:

Anika (Hiring Manager): Thx — please also loop in interviewers who were in yesterday's loop. I'll ping them.

Eli (Interview Training): I'll drop the Loom link once done and add to panel in Lever/Notion.

Carlos (Recruiter Ops): I'll run the patch tonight after we confirm list. Will post a summary when complete.

Maya (People Ops): OK closing the loop — follow up in thread with GH ticket ID and patch summary.
